newsitem.title: USA: Digital Equipment cuts prices on desktops.
newsitem.headline: Digital Equipment cuts prices on desktops.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp said Thursday it was reducing U.S. prices of its personal computer desktop systems by up to 21 percent.

The new prices meet or beat prices from other leading manufacturers, the company said in a statement. The lower prices also reflect its ability to pass on component cost reductions to customers, it said.
The price cuts affect some of Digital's most popular products, including various models of its Venturis and Celebris lines, it said.
